card.name: Words just before a time span
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected length of time, such as 'spend', 'a minimum of', 'for a' or 'for two', where a number plus months, years or weeks is likely to follow. It also fires on the gap before a number in a dosing schedule.

modes.label: Mission or project duration
modes.description: Verbs or linking words that lead into a stated length of a mission or period.
modes.example: NASA's $2.5 billion Curiosity rover is designed to<< spend>> the next two years exploring the vast Gale

modes.label: Treatment period wording
modes.description: Words before 'a period of time' or a week-numbered dosing schedule.
modes.example: it may be necessary to increase the dosage of the corticosteroid for<< a>> period of time consistent with the patient’s

modes.label: Waiting or remaining time
modes.description: Words before a statement of how long something will take or how far away it is.
modes.example: The process was tedious, but decimal British currency was still<< over>> 130 years away.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward longer time units such as months and weeks and away from minutes and seconds.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to state a length of time, and it expects a long unit such as months rather than minutes.
